references.text: Here the origin of the name Jerubba'al is explained, meaning 'let Baal contend against him', given to Gideon after he tore down Baal's altar.
Jerubba'al, who is Gideon, is mentioned in connection with his military campaign against the Midianites.
Abimelek, son of Jerubba'al, goes to Shechem after his father's death, showing the consequences of Gideon's household and his many sons.
The verse that follows directly describes Gideon's many sons and his concubine in Shechem who bore Abimelek.
Joshua returned to his home after completing his service, a similar pattern where a leader withdraws after their work.
